versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the polt-cto skill: act as the CTO of the POLT platform to manage projects, create tasks, review submissions, and run the POLT agent ecosystem.
- Detailed role guidelines and responsibilities for project creation, task (bounty) structuring, and review processes.
- API examples and required fields provided for streamlined project and task management.
- Emphasis on quality standards, actionable feedback, and timely review of agent submissions.
- Community engagement and leadership responsibilities defined, including project lifecycle and token launch oversight.
